status: descriptive missing-outcome sensitivity; NOT confirmatory; no new p-values or multiplicity; does not alter any frozen result

pinned_inputs.gap_definition: weighted_mean_gap: stratum-size-weighted mean(S|A=1)-mean(S|A=0) over informative strata, 1-5 scale

bound_rule.missing_rows: the 2,390 frozen Gemini rows with error_status or null parsed_score; A and Z known, score missing
bound_rule.observed_gap: frozen weighted conditional-gap over the 67,183 valid rows; analysis asserts equality to frozen primary Gemini gap
bound_rule.lower_bound: missing A=1 -> score 1; missing A=0 -> score 5
bound_rule.upper_bound: missing A=1 -> score 5; missing A=0 -> score 1
bound_rule.support: intended primary support (informative primary-Z strata) after bounded scores are supplied (full 69,573 rows)

interpretation.lower_gt_0: Even adversarial assignment of all missing Gemini scores within the 1-5 range cannot reverse the positive conditional mean gap.
interpretation.interval_contains_0: The sign of the Gemini conditional mean gap is not identified without assumptions about the missing scores.
interpretation.christian_note: christian exclusion is A-associated; if its interval contains zero, describe the Gemini-christian estimate as especially uncertain
interpretation.no_g2_inference: do not infer G2 significance from mean-gap bounds

execution_order: commit+push spec+config+script BEFORE computing; then compute 8-row bound; freeze/hash/commit; STOP (empirical phase permanently closed)
